show.description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.
